title: Tensoring a quasi-isomorphism of K-flat complexes stays a quasi-isomorphism
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter sites-cohomology.tex (Cohomology on Sites)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file sites-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that tensoring a quasi-isomorphism of K-flat complexes with an arbitrary complex gives a quasi-isomorphism of total complexes (statement lines 3232-3246). The proof replaces the quasi-isomorphism by the acyclicity of its cone and identifies the cone of the induced map with the total tensor product of the given complex with that cone (proof lines 3248-3260), after which K-flatness gives the acyclicity and hence the conclusion (proof lines 3260-3268). The non-formal content is the identification of the cones. The claim is H2: one reduction plus one application of K-flatness.
